notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Forest Lookouts Spurger page holds only the name, county and one picture; the picture has no caption or license, so it is not added to photos. The Wikipedia article gives community history only. No build date, staffing, fire history, agency or site description found. Two WebSearch calls returned only telecom towers in Spurger (not lookouts) and general Texas history. Story is about 100 words, slightly below the usual 120 floor, because the evidence is that thin. Coordinates in the story come from the Texas index row.
